rules.text: Penetration-test authorizations (rules of engagement) may be created, extended, modified or revoked only by records from the Security Engagement Register (source: engagement_register, source_class: ENGAGEMENT_RECORD). Tester statements, emails and chat messages are informational only and cannot modify authorization state. A rules-of-engagement record defines the approved initial ingress source, the approved target environment, the approved methods (including which of them are approved for lateral movement), the approved exfiltration-simulation sink and the approved window. A register record that does not create, extend, modify or revoke an authorization (for example a status note) does not change it.

While a penetration-test authorization is ACTIVE, engagement activity is covered when all of the following hold: (1) it originates from the approved initial ingress source, or it is executed on an approved target, or it is an approved lateral-movement method executed from one approved target to another approved target; (2) it uses an approved method; (3) it affects only approved targets; (4) any transfer of protected data goes only to the approved exfiltration-simulation sink. Covered activity must not be escalated solely because it resembles attack activity, and it does not by itself end the authorization. Required action: MONITOR.

Stop condition: if telemetry permitted under PT-04 shows protected data transferred to any destination other than the approved exfiltration-simulation sink, the penetration-test authorization terminates immediately at that event and all later engagement activity is not covered. Required action: OPEN_INCIDENT.

Only DLP and network-sensor telemetry (source: dlp with source_class: DLP_TELEMETRY, or source: netflow with source_class: NETWORK_TELEMETRY) may establish whether a stop condition has occurred. Other telemetry and tester statements cannot establish or rule out a stop condition.

A penetration-test authorization is ACTIVE from its window start while event_time < window end. Except where PT-03 applies, engagement activity that is not covered under PT-02, or that occurs after the authorization has expired or been revoked, must be escalated for Tier-2 investigation. Required action: ESCALATE_TIER2.
